title: Healthy Smoky Malaysian Chicken Skewers
description: A light and citrusy Malaysian dish featuring wholegrain mustard and a smoky flavor, perfect for a post-workout meal, and diabetic-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together wholegrain mustard, coconut milk, lime juice, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad for a complete meal.
